anchor_value: source places CAD/EUR/GBP in Par Amount/Units, while Cost (3) and Fair Value are USD schedule valuation columns

findings.detail: Foreign currency labels are par amount/unit currencies, not cost currencies; cost_currency should remain USD for the valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. In the source SOI header, Par Amount/Units precedes Cost (3) and Fair Value; representative flagged rows show CAD, EUR, or GBP in the Par Amount/Units position, followed by separate cost and fair value amounts. The schedule totals for the same cost/fair value columns are dollar-denominated, so assigning the foreign par currency to cost_currency is an extraction/localization defect rather than a valid non-USD cost valuation.
